title: Joe looks out for him; Joe goes to California
summary: Cotton Pickers folded, Joe, Prince and Clyde left for Blanche Calloway, and Joe preferred California to a gig Roy had.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I get the feeling when you've been talking about Joe that he was really looking out for you at that time.

Oh yeah! Yeah, he... Well, it's a funny sort of thing, you know. Well, we went to do that Cotton Picker thing, and then the next thing you know, that folded. And when that folded, Joe, Prince, Clyde, they went with Blanche Calloway, and left me.

And I tried to get Joe to ...(? )...(? )... I was working with Zutty at Ryan's, and then I had to leave one day. They called me... Yeah, they used to call Joe "Don"(? ). He said, "Don(?) wants to go to California with me." I just said, "Well, what can I say? If he wants to go, you know..." ...[INAUDIBLE SENTENCE]... I had a gig for him, but he preferred to go to California. That kind of split the thing up, you know.
